name: hash_mem_multiplier
description: Multiplier applied to work_mem to determine maximum memory available for hash-based operations (e.g., hash joins, hash aggregates).
symptoms: Query cancellation due to memory limits
tuning_tips: Start with 1.5–2.0 for mixed workloads; increase up to 4.0–8.0 only if work_mem is large (>40MB) and hash-heavy queries show memory starvation; monitor RSS and OOM kills.
